derivation: amendment A9: a link element without an href attribute is not an alternate and is not reported; the page keeps its valid self alternate and canonical self.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en">
</head><body></body></html>

name: clean-href-absent
